text:
incident-bot: [P1] High tail latency detected for /v1/generate (p99 ~ 4.2s, p95 ~ 1.1s) across us-west-2 clusters. Streaming stalls observed. Paging oncall.
Alex (oncall): ack, I'm awake. Investigating. Any recent deploys or config changes?
Maya (sre): seeing increased queue depth on quantized pools (int8) and many STREAM_WRITE timeouts in the logs. correlates with a calib job that finished ~10m ago.
John (eng-runtime): Confirmed — we rolled a calibration profile to int8 variants 12m ago as part of batch 2026-03-14T02:20Z. Traffic cutover started at ~02:25Z.
Priya (eng-ml): The calibration used new per-head scale heuristics (auto-scale-v2). We saw small token-level bias but pushed since perf looked good in staging.
Alex (oncall): immediate mitigation options? Can we route traffic back to fp16/previous profile?
John (eng-runtime): yes. We have model variant fallback: `model-x:fp16` and `model-x:int8-calib-v2`. I can trigger a gradual route change to fp16.
Maya (sre): also seeing KV cache eviction spikes on those int8 workers — leads to streaming stalls for long-context sessions.
Ryan (infra): node-level metrics show GPU SM utilization low on affected pods while CPU queue grows — points to runtime stalls, not GPU saturation.
Alex (oncall): John, flip route to fp16 fallback now. Maya, start draining quantized workers. Ryan, hold new scale-ups to int8 pool.
John (eng-runtime): executing rollback: `reroute traffic --from model-x:int8-calib-v2 --to model-x:fp16 --percent 100 --now`
deploy-bot: rolling out traffic reroute to model-x:fp16 — started by John — estimated 30s to fully shift routes.
Maya (sre): initiating drain on int8 pods: `kubectl label node quant-pool=drain && grace=60s`. Also disabling prefix caching temporarily on those pods to reduce KV churn.
Priya (eng-ml): noted. We'll suspend further calibration rollouts until we finish analysis.
Ana (cs): PSA: any customer-facing impact? We have a few big customers on long-context streaming sessions. Do we need to open an incident channel for them?
Alex (oncall): yes, cs-team please prepare a proactive note. Impact window ~02:25Z to now. p99 elevated, some users saw broken streams / partial responses.
Ana (cs): ack. I'll draft a short message and pin in postmortem channel.
Maya (sre): after reroute p99 dropped to ~800ms and streaming stalls dropped sharply. p95 at ~300ms — still slightly elevated vs baseline but within SLO for now.
John (eng-runtime): logs show the int8 kernels hitting dequantization hotpath that triggers a sync on the KV manager when calibration maps contain unexpected per-head shapes. That sync caused head-of-line stalls.
Priya (eng-ml): aha — auto-scale-v2 produced per-head scales for some attention heads that differ from what runtime expects for fused kernels. Staging didn't exercise long-context streaming, so missed the behavior.
Alex (oncall): root cause hypothesis captured. Immediate mitigation: rollback of calib profile, drain int8 workers, route to fp16. Medium-term: add long-context streaming test and stronger kernel compatibility checks.
Maya (sre): creating incident ticket and paging followups. Assigning runbook items:
- Maya: collect full KV manager traces and tail logs (done by EOD)
- John: instrumentation for per-head scale validation and safe-fallback in runtime (PR + test by EOD+1)
- Priya: revert auto-scale-v2 for prod and run extended streaming calibration in staging (by EOD+2)
- Ryan: snapshot affected nodes and preserve metrics window (do not recycle until confirmed)
- Ana: customer comms draft and list of potentially impacted accounts (ASAP)
Alex (oncall): I'm handing off to Maya for the next shift. I'll remain reachable for escalations.
Maya (sre): taking over. Current status: mitigation applied, metrics improving but monitoring for 1h. Starting post-incident data capture.
John (eng-runtime): quick snippet of the offending log if helpful:
```
[2026-03-14T02:27:12Z] kernel: fused_attn_dispatch - per_head_scales shape mismatch expected (H_per_head=64) got (H_per_head=32) -> invoking KV_sync -> stall
[2026-03-14T02:27:12Z] runtime: KV manager blocked for 312ms
```
Priya (eng-ml): adding to the incident board: calibration->compatibility test gap + staging coverage gap.
Ana (cs): posted customer note to #customers-alerts and flagged 2 enterprise accounts (acct-omega, acct-sigma) for proactive outreach.
Maya (sre): monitoring alert: p99 back to baseline in most shards, a couple outliers with intermittent 1.2s spikes — investigating.
Maya (sre): next steps: preserve logs, collect heap/kv snapshots, re-run calibration in isolated env with long-streaming harness.
Alex (oncall): good handoff. I'll add context to the incident ticket before I go.
Maya (sre): thanks — will update when we have full RCA. For now incident severity -> P1 to P2 pending stabilisation. :white_check_mark:
